settings.heading: 1,000+ customers and counting
settings.text:
TOOSA was founded by two friends who have known each other for more than 18 years. We had always talked about starting a business together, and TOOSA gave us the chance to finally do it.

Since launching in February 2024 we've grown from one Marketplace listing into a community of 1,000+ customers across Canada. The number matters less than what it stands for: the garages, shops, fabrication spaces and businesses our customers have built around their TOOSA systems. Every new customer joins the TOOSA family and gives us another chance to make the products better.

settings.caption: A customer shop

settings.heading: Build your workspace. Your way.
settings.text:
We're just getting started, and we don't want TOOSA to be just another tool cabinet company. We're building a broader ecosystem of modular workspace and shop solutions designed around the people who use them.

Tool storage is where we started. As our customers' needs evolve, so will we. Whether you're setting up a first home garage, running a professional shop or growing a business, our goal is simple: help people build better workspaces.
